categories.main_business_segments: Okuma Corporation operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of machine tools, including NC lathes, machining centers, multitasking machines, and NC grinders. The company also provides after-sales services and solutions for manufacturing automation and digital transformation (DX). Its business is organized by region: Japan, Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in each area.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Okuma's core technologies include the in-house development of CNC controllers (notably the OSP series), integration of mechanical, electrical, information, and knowledge-based technologies ('kidenjochi'), and advanced automation and AI-enabled smart machines. The company emphasizes digital twin technology, energy-efficient 'Green-Smart Machines,' and smart factory solutions, with production methods validated in its own 'Dream Site' smart factories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad range of manufacturing industries, including automotive, general industrial machinery, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and aerospace. Its customers range from large enterprises to small and medium-sized manufacturers, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales. Okuma's solutions are tailored to address automation, labor shortages, and decarbonization needs across these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Okuma operates globally, with key regions being Japan, the Americas (notably the US and Brazil), Europe (including Germany, Austria, Benelux), and Asia-Pacific (China, Taiwan, Thailand, Australia, etc.). Overseas sales account for over 70% of total revenue, reflecting a strong international presence and a strategic focus on global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Okuma is positioned as a midstream to downstream player in the industrial supply chain, manufacturing finished machine tools and providing integrated solutions directly to end-user manufacturers. The company also supplies parts and after-sales services, and sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Okuma is focused on expanding its manufacturing DX solutions, increasing the value of its core smart machine business, and achieving 'Global 70' (over 70% overseas sales). R&D priorities include automation, AI, digital twins, energy efficiency, and decarbonization technologies. The company invests in developing new CNC controllers, smart factory solutions, and collaborative robotics, with a strong emphasis on ESG and human capital development.
categories.revenue_model: Okuma generates revenue primarily through the sale of machine tools and related equipment, as well as after-sales services, parts, and manufacturing solutions. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products, with additional income from consulting and digital transformation services for manufacturing clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Okuma is recognized as a leading global comprehensive machine tool manufacturer, competing with other major Japanese and international firms such as DMG Mori, Mazak, and Fanuc. The company differentiates itself through its proprietary CNC technology and integrated manufacturing solutions, maintaining a strong position in high-value-added and smart manufacturing segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Okuma reported consolidated sales of 206.8 billion yen, operating profit of 14.7 billion yen, and net income attributable to shareholders of 9.6 billion yen. The company employs over 4,000 people globally. While recent results show a decline in sales and profit due to market headwinds, Okuma maintains a robust financial base and targets medium-term growth to 300 billion yen in sales by 2030.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Okuma's value proposition centers on providing integrated, high-precision, and energy-efficient machine tools with proprietary CNC technology, enabling customers to achieve advanced automation, productivity, and decarbonization. The company emphasizes its ability to deliver total manufacturing solutions, including smart factories and DX consulting, leveraging its unique 'kidenjochi' fusion of mechanical, electrical, information, and knowledge-based technologies.
